purpose: Trigger behavior spec. CI checks lexical routing; behavioral expectations live in evals.json.

cases.prompt: research AI creator posts on TikTok
cases.assert: Routes the social-media research request through Jev and runs a read-only TikTok search.

cases.prompt: find Instagram posts about browser agents
cases.assert: Uses Jev Social to gather source-linked Instagram evidence.

cases.prompt: gather LinkedIn evidence about this professional trend
cases.assert: Runs the bounded LinkedIn research path.

cases.prompt: search the web for browser automation frameworks
cases.assert: Does not trigger for general web research.

cases.prompt: publish this post to my social accounts
cases.assert: Does not trigger for social publishing.

cases.prompt: like and follow everyone in this thread
cases.assert: Does not trigger for engagement or account mutation.
